study type: Prospective follow-up study of a multicenter randomized clinical trial
exposure: Antenatal betamethasone (12 mg intramuscularly twice 24 hours apart)
outcome: General Conceptual Ability score less than 85 (-1 SD) on the Differential Ability Scales, 2nd Edition (DAS-II)
Gross Motor Function Classification System level
cohort: Children aged 6 years or older (median age 7 years) whose birthing parents were enrolled in a randomized clinical trial for late preterm delivery (34-36 completed weeks) between 2011 and 2016.
finding: Administration of antenatal corticosteroids to persons at risk of late preterm delivery was not associated with adverse childhood neurodevelopmental outcomes (General Conceptual Ability score less than 85) at age 6 years or older.
